metaDescription: Your cart as a day-by-day itinerary, with date and acclimatization notices.
title: My trip
empty: When you add tours to your cart you will see your day-by-day plan here, with notices about overlapping dates and altitude acclimatization.
range: From {from} to {to} · {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} · {tours, plural, one {# tour} other {# tours}}
sameDay: {titles} are on the same day in the same city. We will make sure the schedules do not clash.
freeDays: {count, plural, one {Free or transfer day} other {Free or transfer days}}
tooLong: Your trip lasts more than 4 months; we show it up to {date}.
pickupText: Pickup times are confirmed when you book, in Lima time. The calendar will include them once confirmed.
whatsapp: Questions about your plan? Message us on WhatsApp

altitude.title: Altitude acclimatization
altitude.text: Puno, Cusco and the Colca are above 3,400 m. Arriving a day early, staying hydrated and eating light reduces altitude sickness (soroche).
altitude.from: You are coming from {region}, at {meters} m: the change in altitude is big.
altitude.demanding: This is a demanding tour for the altitude: we recommend arriving at least one day early and resting.
altitude.easy: If you arrive that same day, we recommend resting for a few hours and taking it easy.
altitude.notBlocking: (A recommendation; it does not block your booking.)

ics.pickup: Pickup time and place: we will confirm them on WhatsApp (Lima time).
ics.notConfirmed: Booking pending payment: this calendar does not confirm seats.

conflict.title: These tours overlap
conflict.help: Change the date of one of them or confirm it is correct (for example, if different groups are traveling).
conflict.confirmed: You confirmed the dates. You can now continue with the booking.
